notes:
## What's new
- **Ren'Py support**: open Ren'Py 7 and 8 saves (`1-1-LT1.save`, `auto-…`, `quick-…`) and edit game variables by name (money, affection points, flags, names…), including attributes of game objects such as `mc_inventory.money`; every other value is in the Advanced tab
  - Edits stay after loading: Ren'Py rolls back to the start of the line it was saved on, and the editor updates the values it restores there too
  - Ren'Py 8.1+ asks whether you trust an edited save when you load it; answer **Yes**
- **Tables** (Items, Weapons, Armors, Switches, Variables):
  - The header stays visible while scrolling
  - Quick filters (e.g. owned only, changed only, different from the old save) and a count of the rows shown
  - The Old and GAP columns are easier to read (`+5` / `-3` in color, ON/OFF) and can be searched too
  - Undo a single edit with ↺, and move between values with Enter / Shift+Enter and the arrow keys
  - Long lists stay fast, also when a filter is cleared
- **Advanced tab**:
  - **Changes** lists every value not saved yet, from any tab, with Undo all
  - Item, weapon, armor, switch and variable IDs show their names from the game, and you can search by name (`potion`, `name:"Hi Potion"`)
  - Search suggestions as you type, and a path bar for the selected value
  - The save data gets more room: resize or hide the search results, and hide the notice
- **Website**: https://truongthang2211.github.io/RPGSaveEditor/ (also linked in About)

## Fixes
- "Unsaved" now goes away when every edited value is put back to its original value
- Ctrl+S now saves while you're typing in a field
